references.text: God's covenant with Abraham regarding circumcision as a sign of the covenant. Zipporah circumcises her son in accordance with this covenantal ordinance.
The law requiring circumcision of male infants on the eighth day, showing that circumcision was a fundamental obligation in Israel.
Joshua circumcises the Israelites at Gilgal, emphasizing the importance of circumcision before entering the Promised Land, just as Zipporah performed it before Moses could complete his mission.
The continuation of the account where the Lord let Moses go after the circumcision, and Zipporah repeats the expression 'bride of blood'.
Zipporah is mentioned again as Moses' wife, highlighting her role in Moses' life and family.
